title: Canonical Source Synthesis
boundary: This browser prototype compares structured JSON fields. It does not read repositories, infer document authority, or publish a canonical source.

title: Career Evidence System
boundary: Deterministic tag matching supports retrieval. It does not assess qualification, invent accomplishments, or access Ali’s private career database.

title: Inventory Truth Ledger
boundary: A new browser prototype of the reconciliation rules. Quantities are manually supplied; no ERP, WMS, carrier, or quality system is connected.

title: SmartGrocer Forecast
boundary: This public browser prototype demonstrates forecasting and review using manual inputs. The private authenticated implementation, household isolation, retailer prices, and receipt parsing are separate.

title: Unseen Lifeline
boundary: A new browser prototype of the notice-review pattern. It recognizes explicitly written ISO dates only. It does not interpret eligibility, calculate legal deadlines, contact agencies, or submit a response.

title: Unseen OS Continuity Review
boundary: A new browser prototype of continuity review with editable fictional records. It does not ingest documents, synchronize inboxes, send reminders, or reproduce the separate local v0.3 implementation.

title: Role-Based Document Review
boundary: An interactive reconstruction using fictional records. It demonstrates routing gates, without accessing employer records or granting SharePoint permissions.

title: Project Coordination Package Check
boundary: An interactive reconstruction using fictional amounts and records. Readiness is an administrative check; it cannot approve contracts, authorize payment, or update a financial system.

title: Retail Planning Scenario
boundary: A reconstructed planning calculator using fictional inputs. It illustrates an operating method, not a historical employer forecast or verified business result. Demand is assumed constant.

title: Interview Preparation Workbench
boundary: A new text-only browser companion using deterministic prompts and a self-review checklist. It does not call Gemini, conduct a voice interview, score candidates, or verify the externally hosted application.
